facts.fact: NimbaPay, Guinea's instant payment system, is carried by the BCRG and operated by Guinéenne de Monétique, whose board the BCRG First Deputy Governor chairs; it was put in service with first transaction on 23 June 2026 and official launch on 22 July 2026.

GIN.note: Nothing on government payments to people.
A payment system and its operator are described; no law or rule stated.
A 30% financial inclusion rate is cited as a programme baseline with no survey or account measure named.

facts.fact: NimbaPay went live with three e-money institutions, three banks and one microfinance institution and two use cases, and processed over GNF 100 billion in its first four months.
NimbaPay in service links banks, e-money institutions and a microfinance institution, so payments pass between wallets and banks.
NimbaPay is described as Guinea's instant and inclusive payment system, operated by Guinéenne de Monétique for the BCRG, with a new wave of institutions expected by the end of December 2026.

GIN.note: Nothing on payment of taxes or fees.
